sections.text_helper: Section 43.4.1 "AXI master" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2097.
sections.section_content:
The AXI master busses perform the accesses to the memory and are driven by the internal
logic. The LTDC internal per-layer FIFOs are fairly large to cope with reasonably long
external memory latencies.
The LDTC generates long burst (128-byte) for higher external memory efficiency.
Formoregranularity, it is possible to decrease the max burst size to 64bytes, but it is not
recommended.
Parameter in LTDC_LxBLCR
BL: burst length, in 64-bit words, with a default 0 for max size
Default configuration
The default AXI burst length is set at its maximum value after reset, with BL=0.
